inputs.commit_message: chore: verify ASOL cutover completion gates
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo '--- TOOLS ---'
(command -v codex && codex --version) || true
(command -v claude && claude --version) || true
run_gate(){ name="$1"; shift; echo "===== $name ====="; set +e; "$@"; rc=$?; set -e; echo "GATE:$name:$rc"; }
run_gate architecture npm run architecture:check
run_gate notifications npm run test:notifications
run_gate ota_core npm run test:ota-core
run_gate control_verify npm run control:verify
run_gate control_build npm run control:build
run_gate control_smoke npm run control:smoke
run_gate vercel_deploy_core npm run test:vercel-deploy-core
run_gate deployment_tools npm run test:deployment-tools
run_gate typecheck npm run typecheck
run_gate lint npm run lint
run_gate github_policy npm run github:ci-policy
echo '--- STATUS ---'
git status --short
echo ASOL_COMPLETION_GATE_SCAN=DONE
